<!-- Source of truth: actions/registry.yaml action JEV_BOOTSTRAP. Re-run the generator to update. -->

Execute the Jev decision-layer bootstrap wizard non-interactively: `bash constitution/scripts/jev/bootstrap.sh --non-interactive` (fall back to `bash scripts/jev/bootstrap.sh --non-interactive` when the constitution is the project root). The wizard runs detect → provision (llmctl + claude_toolkit) → detect decision models → install per-agent artifacts → configure → shadow-calibrate → verify, reporting progress at every stage. If the wizard fails, its own `--defer` fallback records a pending stamp; surface the failure per §11.4.6 — never claim bootstrap done without the stamp.
